prompt: Which code correctly creates and displays a minimal JFrame?
choices: JFrame f = new JFrame("App"); f.setSize(400,300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setVisible(true);
explanation: A minimal working JFrame needs: a title, a size (or pack()), a close operation, and setVisible(true). Option A uses deprecated show(). Options C and D use non-existent methods.
